# Maintainable accessible frontend

- Use focused typed React components and shared hooks; keep domain calculations out of presentation. Use existing file structure and naming instead of reorganising broadly.
- Preserve live preview, real dates/settings, searchable selectors and mobile full-screen preview. Complete loading, empty, error, offline and retry states.
- Use design tokens for spacing, typography, accents and light/dark/system themes. Keep invoice print colours independent of app theme.
- Provide labels, visible focus, keyboard-operable dialogs, meaningful errors and reduced-motion alternatives. Validate desktop and phone layouts.
- Use one source of truth for document data. Frontend estimates must agree with authoritative server calculations.
- Avoid unsafe HTML injection, unnecessary global state, broad any casts and animation that interferes with editing.
